# ShadowTalk AI

> ShadowTalk AI is a privacy-first agentic AI workspace. Open the site at /chatbot for the main product. Marketing lives at /home. It runs autonomous missions, 30+ tools (chat, code, voice, vision, research, security), BYOK providers, and optional on-device models via WebGPU.

## Entry & navigation

- [/](/): Redirects to /chatbot (workspace).
- [/chatbot](/chatbot): Primary AI workspace — chat, tools, missions, marketplace agents.
- [/home](/home): Marketing landing — features, pricing section, neural dock navigation.
- [/auth](/auth): Sign in or link account (session persists; anonymous auto-sign-in unless user signed out).

## Core product

- [Mission Control](/missioncontrol): Autonomous multi-step AI missions with approval gates.
- [Deep Research](/research): Multi-step research (also from chat tools).
- [Strategy Agent](/strategy): Business intelligence and analysis.
- [Workspace](/workspace): Team and business context.
- [Creative Studio](/studio): AI media and document creative tools.
- [Presentation Builder](/presentations): Slide decks from prompts.
- [Code IDE](/ide): Monaco IDE, multi-file projects, live preview, App Builder output.
- [Knowledge Graph](/knowledge): Entity and relationship graph.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Installable specialist AI agents.

## Privacy & security

- [Cyber Command](/cyber): Security operations modules.
- [Security Audit](/security-audit): Code and URL security analysis.
- [Stealth Vault](/vault): Encrypted sensitive storage.
- [Privacy Score](/privacy-score): Privacy posture scoring.
- [Transparency](/transparency): Data handling and encryption practices.
- [Trust](/trust): Security and compliance posture.
- [Sovereign Data](/sovereign-data): Data sovereignty controls.

## Technical notes for crawlers

- Default user flow: workspace-first at /chatbot, no marketing boot screen on chat entry.
- Hardware-aware routing selects local WebGPU/WASM vs cloud automatically (no “Turbo” UI badge in composer).
- Offline: SmolLM (Tier A) and optional Gemma (Tier B); see product docs and /settings.
- Repository documentation: https://github.com/zain836/shadowtalk-ai-903ca615 (DOCUMENTATION.md, Detailed Documentation/)
